name: Kessa Vantree
classText: Scout / Guide. The map is a guess. The Wayfinder is the answer. Primary stat: Dexterity. Secondary: Wisdom. Weak spot: Charisma.
classAbility: Once per scene, after a check is failed (yours or an ally's), you may flip the top card of your hero deck. If it's a Dexterity card, the check succeeds instead.
backstoryStrength: When you play a Dexterity card on a check to track, scout, find a path, or move through the wild, add +1 to the Card Value.
backstoryFlaw: When the Adventure Deck reveals a card tagged Debt, Caravan, or Home, Kessa must choose one: take on the side quest (add it to your tableau), or take 1 Wound card.
companionText: Companion, Hero's Party slot (ongoing). Once per turn, when you make an on-stat DEX or INT check, add +1 to your total.
